verses.englishText: When the sky has split [open]
And has listened [i.e., responded][1888] to its Lord and was obligated [to do so]
verses.footnotes: [1888] It will have heard Allāh's command and will have inclined immediately to compliance and willing obedience.

verses.englishText: And when the earth has been extended[1889]
verses.footnotes: [1889] i.e., stretched flat and spread out.

verses.englishText: And has cast out that within it[1890] and relinquished [it]
verses.footnotes: [1890] Of the dead and all else buried therein.

verses.englishText: And has listened [i.e., responded] to its Lord and was obligated [to do so] –

verses.arabicText: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدْحًا فَمُلَـٰقِيهِ
verses.englishText: O mankind, indeed you are laboring toward your Lord with [great] exertion[1891] and will meet it.[1892]
verses.footnotes:
[1891] i.e., striving throughout your life until you meet your Lord, hastening toward death.
[1892] i.e., you will find all that you intended and accomplished awaiting you in the Hereafter. Another meaning is "And will meet Him [i.e., your Lord]" and be recompensed in full by Him.

verses.englishText: Then as for he who is given his record in his right hand,
He will be judged with an easy account
And return to his people in happiness.

verses.arabicText: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ وَرَآءَ ظَهْرِهِۦ
verses.englishText: But as for he who is given his record behind his back,
He will cry out for destruction
And [enter to] burn in a Blaze.
Indeed, he had [once] been among his people in happiness;
Indeed, he had thought he would never return [to Allāh].

verses.arabicText: بَلَىٰٓ إِنَّ رَبَّهُۥ كَانَ بِهِۦ بَصِيرًا
verses.englishText: But yes! Indeed, his Lord was ever, of him, Seeing.
So I swear by the twilight glow
And [by] the night and what it envelops
And [by] the moon when it becomes full
[That] you will surely embark upon [i.e., experience] state after state.[1893]
verses.footnotes: [1893] i.e., various stages, both in this life and in the Hereafter.

verses.englishText: So what is [the matter] with them [that] they do not believe,

verses.arabicText: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ لَا يَسْجُدُونَ ۩
verses.englishText: And when the Qur’ān is recited to them, they do not prostrate [to Allāh]?
But those who have disbelieved deny,
And Allāh is most knowing of what they keep within themselves.
So give them tidings of a painful punishment,

verses.arabicText: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۭ
verses.englishText: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds. For them is a reward uninterrupted.
